ja279:1.1: As the young brahmin on the path thinks
ja279:1.2: the jackal who ranged the woods,
ja279:1.4: was one who desired to harm him,
ja279:1.6: who desired harm, one who desired good.
ja279:2.1: So does a certain person here,
ja279:2.2: who is of such a kind,
ja279:2.3: When a beneficial word is spoken,
ja279:2.4: take it in the opposite sense.
ja279:3.2: or exalt him out of fear,
ja279:3.4: as the young brahmin thinks of the woodpecker.
